description: SQLite WAL-mode event storage with dual-trigger pruning

requirements.title: SQLite WAL mode storage
requirements.description: Events stored in SQLite with WAL mode, busy_timeout=10000, synchronous=NORMAL

requirements.title: WAL mode pragma configuration
requirements.description: SQLite configured with journal_mode=WAL, busy_timeout=10000, synchronous=NORMAL pragmas

requirements.title: WAL mode verified at store construction
requirements.description: NewSQLiteStore applies WAL pragmas during construction and verifies they take effect

requirements.title: GetSince for replay support
requirements.description: Store provides GetSince(lastID, limit) for SSE replay on reconnection

requirements.title: Event schema
requirements.description: Events table with id (autoincrement), event_id (unique), source_scenario, target_scenario, event_type, correlation_id, payload (BLOB), metadata (JSON), created_at. Duplicate event_id returns ErrDuplicateEvent (409 Conflict at API level).

requirements.title: Dual-trigger pruning
requirements.description: Background goroutine at configurable interval deletes events older than retention window or when total size exceeds size cap.

requirements.title: Time-based retention pruning
requirements.description: Prune events older than configurable retention window (default: 30 days)

requirements.title: Configurable prune interval
requirements.description: Prune cycle interval configurable via environment (default: 6 hours)

requirements.title: Size-based capacity pruning
requirements.description: Prune oldest events when total store size exceeds size cap (default: 2GB)

requirements.title: Configurable retention settings
requirements.description: Retention window, size cap, and prune interval configurable via environment and settings.

requirements.title: WAL checkpoint verification
requirements.description: Verifies WAL mode pragma took effect via PRAGMA query after construction

requirements.title: GetSince cursor-based pagination
requirements.description: Pagination uses cursor-based approach with last seen ID for efficient replay

requirements.title: Table schema and indexing
requirements.description: Events table with composite indexes on event_id, source_scenario, event_type, correlation_id

requirements.title: Unique constraint on event_id
requirements.description: UNIQUE constraint on event_id column enables idempotent ingestion with 409 Conflict

requirements.title: Metadata JSON serialization
requirements.description: Metadata stored as JSON text column with structured key-value pairs

requirements.title: Interval ticker goroutine lifecycle
requirements.description: Prune ticker goroutine starts with store and stops on Close()

requirements.title: Database size estimation query
requirements.description: Size estimation via page_count * page_size PRAGMA for pruning threshold

requirements.title: Environment variable configuration
requirements.description: Retention settings configurable via PRUNE_INTERVAL, RETENTION_DAYS, SIZE_CAP_MB env vars

requirements.title: Default value fallbacks
requirements.description: Sensible defaults when env vars not set: 6h interval, 30d retention, 2GB cap

requirements.title: Runtime settings update
requirements.description: Settings modifiable at runtime via API without restart
